name: Lahore
angle: Many Lahore businesses compete for the same searches, so naming the area and the exact service in your ads and on your page usually works better than a general message.

name: Karachi
angle: Karachi is large and spread out, so it helps to target only the areas you can really serve. That avoids paying for clicks from people who are too far away to become customers.

name: Islamabad
angle: Many people in Islamabad search for a service in a particular sector, so naming the sector in your ads and on your page helps the right customers find you.

name: Rawalpindi
angle: Rawalpindi and Islamabad are close to each other. Decide clearly whether you serve one city or both, so your ads reach the right people and you do not pay for clicks outside your service area.
